# Better Destroy Stages!

This resource pack focuses on improving Minecraft's visuals by adding colored cues to Minecraft's block-breaking stages. 
You can check out some previews in the "Gallery" section.

## Support

Feel free to dm me on my discord if you have any issues or suggestions. Happy mining!
